summary: Codex gocli1219-r1 fixes in the 4.34.2 client: a mutation carrying a per-call Idempotency-Key (the spec-declared --idempotency-key flags) is sent through a dedicated HTTP/1 client with keep-alives off (noReuseMutationClient), so Go's transport never resends it on a dead reused connection and the CLI never replays it; a binary (streaming) response wraps the transport already chosen for the call instead of the shared client; the broken-response-body retry checks the provider retry budget (retryWithinBudget) like the network/429/5xx branches; a platform limiter wait that ends on the context returns the stop classification (failCtx) like the adaptive limiter; the cross-origin allowlist is proven on a followed redirect to a public-looking host (test resolver + dialer), the loopback-literal case stays a pure refusal test.
reason: Codex gocli1219-r1: P1 transport-level replay of keyed mutations, P2 body-reset retry ignoring the provider budget, P2 streaming mutations falling back to the shared HTTP/2 client, P3 limiter error classification, P3 a test that fabricated its success state.
validated_outcome: TestPerCallKeyedMutationDroppedOnAWarmConnectionIsSentOnce, TestStreamingMutationKeepsTheNoReplayTransport, TestBrokenBodyRetryHonoursThePlatformRetryBudget and TestPlatformLimiterWaitOnARetryKeepsTheLastResponse each fail with their fix reverted and pass with it; TestPublicCrossOriginRedirectCarriesOnlyAllowlistedHeaders asserts the headers the target actually received.
